notes: Two decision reversals in one session — stresses supersession without an explicit 'switched from' marker on the second.

messages.content: We need to migrate 40M rows from MySQL to Postgres with no downtime.
Decided: dual-write during migration. Created migrations/001_dual_write.sql and scripts/backfill.py.
dual write is too risky, use logical replication instead
Switching from dual-write to logical replication. Decided: pglogical for the replication layer. Updated scripts/backfill.py.
pglogical needs a superuser we don't have. use AWS DMS.
Decided: AWS DMS instead of pglogical. Created infra/dms_task.tf.
backfill is timing out on the orders table
Fixed the backfill timeout by batching at 10k rows in scripts/backfill.py. Completed the orders table backfill.
Working on a row count reconciliation script. Will add scripts/verify_counts.py.
